title: Bond-pinning, the two-block window and localisation
claim: In a living in-scope nested NAE family: (P') shattered sets of main's ports and of a covered copy's own distinctions that are jointly non-full contain a bond of at most their total size; (two-block window) the projection onto main's whole block and the target block is exact, so its bonds bound L; (localisation) if L is bounded by C on a residue, some bond of size at most C has its occupied levels within C*m*(Pi+1) of the root or the target. Decidability of boundedness is open.
standard_statement: Two sufficient certificates for bounded least minimal non-shattered sets in iterated hyperedge-replacement NAE instances, and a localisation of bounded ones by finite-monoid pumping.
prior_work: READ-RULE-20261114-001 (Theorem R, the dichotomy); CARRY-BOUND-20261114-001 (Lemma W).

validation.status: hand proofs, checked twice by the advisor model (a colleague's check); referee pending

remaining_obligations: Decidability of boundedness (an a priori bound on the least bounded value) is open
foundation_claim_scope: Statements about bonds in nested NAE families; no knot, contact or topology claim beyond them.
completion_gate: The proofs of P', the two-block bound and localisation written and checked.
